decision_diagnostics.source: Repeated leakage-safe outer-fold predictions; every development row is evaluated once per outer seed.

evaluation_protocol.calibration: sigmoid calibration fit only on group-safe training folds
evaluation_protocol.grouping: connected components sharing student_id or normalized feature fingerprint
evaluation_protocol.threshold: chosen inside training folds to maximize macro-F1

interpretation.warning: Associations and model estimates are not causal. Use scores for supportive outreach, never punitive decisions.

overlap_audit.impact: The official test set is not independent and cannot estimate generalization.
overlap_audit.remediation: Quarantine matching training rows before target analysis and use grouped cross-validation on the remaining cohort.
